verification_policy: Situation Room is treated as discovery/context only. Items below are not promoted to primary-source verified events by this file.

review_scope.requested: Current date backward, deduplicated against existing repository coverage
review_scope.current_date_status: No 2026-08-28 briefing was visible in the public Situation Room briefing archive at review time; latest visible briefing was 2026-08-27. Do not infer a missing event from absence of a briefing.

relevant_items.title: Ray Dalio says investors should own a bit of Bitcoin as U.S. debt risks rise
relevant_items.interpretation: Supportive structural narrative, but Situation Room explicitly noted that the endorsement had not yet produced visible spot accumulation. Treat as readiness/context, not demand confirmation.

relevant_items.title: U.S. sanctions pressure Iran trade channels while Tehran threatens Gulf oil exports
relevant_items.interpretation: Maintains an energy/inflation tail risk that can tighten financial conditions even when BTC-specific narratives are constructive.

relevant_items.title: Strive adds 1,110 BTC to treasury via share sales
relevant_items.interpretation: Positive BTC-specific demand, but the following briefing recorded a price decline and concluded that equity-funded corporate buying did not automatically neutralize distribution pressure.

relevant_items.title: U.S. targets Iran trade lifelines and maintains elevated Middle East military posture
relevant_items.interpretation: Continues the inflation/liquidity headwind channel and argues against treating isolated BTC demand as ecosystem-wide risk-on evidence.

relevant_items.title: Wall Street rolls out tools for whales to exit self-custody
relevant_items.interpretation: Structurally important. Easier transfer into regulated instruments can increase institutional absorption capacity but also lowers friction for large holders to reposition. It is not a short-term bullish catalyst by itself.

relevant_items.title: U.S. debt concern persists while 10-year real yield remains strongly positive
relevant_items.interpretation: A positive real-yield regime remains a meaningful opportunity-cost headwind for crypto and other long-duration risk assets.

relevant_items.title: Hormuz/Iran economic pressure remains unresolved
relevant_items.interpretation: Keeps geopolitical energy risk active even as immediate market volatility stays contained.

relevant_items.title: Bitcoin below $79,000 as traders start betting on a Fed hike
relevant_items.interpretation: Directly relevant to current DATA PING interpretation: higher-rate expectations can pressure risk assets and reduce the significance of otherwise supportive ETF/stablecoin inputs.

relevant_items.title: Tanker attack tests claims that Hormuz is functioning normally
relevant_items.interpretation: Energy-risk transmission remains live and can re-tighten financial conditions without an immediate volatility spike.

relevant_items.title: Qatar seeks to revive U.S.-Iran talks
relevant_items.interpretation: Potential counterweight to the Hormuz risk premium, but only a diplomatic attempt at this stage, not confirmed de-escalation.

relevant_items.title: StarkWare demonstrates first quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction via MARA Slipstream
relevant_items.interpretation: Long-horizon network resilience development, but Situation Room notes high cost and nonstandard relay requirements. No immediate cycle or rotation impact.

relevant_items.title: $8.4tn sovereign debt maturity wall in 2026
relevant_items.interpretation: Important background stressor. Large refinancing needs can keep term yields and liquidity competition elevated even without acute market stress.

cross_briefing_synthesis.dominant_context: BTC-specific structural demand and institutionalization coexist with persistent macro/rates and Hormuz energy headwinds.
cross_briefing_synthesis.framework_read: Supports BTC resilience/absorption more than broad crypto transmission. No Situation Room evidence reviewed here justifies rotation or altseason promotion.
